The Environmental Changes that Took Place when the Sahabah (RA) were Killed
Fresh Blood Rains down during the "Year of Jamaa'ah"

Hadhrat Rabee'ah bin Qusayt reports, "I was with Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) during the "Year of Jamaa'ah" (the year in which the armies of Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) clashed in battle). The army was returning when there came a downpour of fresh blood. I saw myself holding up a utensil that was filled with blood and everyone knew that this was the blood of each other that they had spilled. Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) then stood up, duly praised Allaah and said, 'O people! Mend your relationship with Allaah and even if these two mountains have to collide, you will not be harmed in the least.'"[^3]
Blood is Discovered beneath Stones when Hadhrat Husayn (RA) was Martyred

Hadhrat Zuhri reports, "Abdul Malik once said to me, 'If you can tell me what was the sign of Hadhrat Husayn (RA)'s martyrdom, you can truly be called a great scholar.' I replied, 'Fresh blood was found beneath every stone lifted in Baytul Maqdas.' Abdul Malik then said to me, 'You and I are contemporaries in this narration."[^4]
Another narration, he says, "The day Hadhrat Husayn (AS) was martyred, every stone lifted in Shaam gave way to blood."[^5]
The Sky Turns Red and Eclipses the day Hadhrat Husayn was Martyred
Hadhrat Ummu Hakeem (RA) says, "I was still a little girl when Hadhrat Husayn (RA) was martyred. For a few days afterwards, the sky remained the colour of a blood clot."[^6]
